name: Erythritol
siboNotes: Well-tolerated sugar alcohol that's absorbed in the small intestine before reaching the colon, making it less likely to cause digestive symptoms than other polyols.
preparationTips: Use 70% of the amount you would use of regular sugar in recipes
Dissolves well in both hot and cold liquids
May have a slight cooling effect on the tongue
Works well in baking but doesn't caramelize like sugar
nutritionalHighlights: Does not affect blood sugar levels
Does not contribute to tooth decay
